MRI Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Kestrel Vascular Stent System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 3-Tesla or less
• Spatial field gradient: ≤ 30 T/m (3,000 G/cm) or less
• Gradient slew rate limited to 100 T/m/s per axis
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.5 W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• Use the body transmit coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Kestrel Vascular Stent System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
